mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active in any monetary regime.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and GDP growth indicates robust economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to stronger corporate earnings and investor confidence.
failure_condition: The joint effect of rising HOUST and GDPC1 does not produce positive returns in 60% or more of instances (i.e., Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 200.0), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in 60% or more of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200.0.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly payroll employment growth exceeds 100,000 (PAYEMS > 100.0), it signals a strong labor market and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where PAYEMS > 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.7%) indicates a monetary tightening cycle amid a strong labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and growth concerns.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market strength
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE < 4.7%) does not lead to negative returns in 60% or more of instances (i.e., returns are positive in 60% or more of such cases).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0), the economy is slowing, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in 60% or more of instances when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of the broader economic regime.
failure_condition: Rank IC for RSAFS remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
